subject: Flexible safety net & rollover credit path for short-term spike
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@clearnorth.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: launchio-ops@clearnorth.com
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected launch spike — short-term uplift & credits?

Hi Naomi,

We pushed a feature last night and saw a 6x token spike in the morning window. Our product team has throttled, but we need a short-term uplift for the next 48 hours to avoid degraded user experience. Can Redwood provision a temporary quota increase or a rate-limit override?

Two asks:
- Temporary uplift for 48 hours with a clear per-token rate (so we can justify to finance)
- If we convert this to a 12-month commit within 60 days, is there a credit/discount for the overrun? We want any overage to be usable against a future commit (rollover credit).

Attaching a minute-level spike extract for the window.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Ops, ClearNorth
attachments: CN_spike_logs_20261218.csv
From: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearnorth.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — short-term uplift & credits?

Hi Samira — thanks for the data, that helps. I pulled the spike and worked with infra to estimate headroom profiles. Short answer: we can stand up a 48-hour uplift with a temporary rate and offer a conditional rollover credit if you convert to a committed annual plan.

Proposal (high level):
- 48-hour flex safety-net: +250% quota from current tier, activated immediately; metered at a temporary uplift rate of $0.0085 per 1k tokens (discounted from standard pay-as-you-go).
- Rollover credit: 70% of the billed uplift during the 48-hour window can be applied as a one-time credit if ClearNorth signs a 12-month committed plan with minimum $75k monthly commit within 60 days.
- Billing: uplift will appear as a separate line item in the next invoice; credit issues after contract signature and PO.

Next steps:
1) Ben and I will prepare a short proposal and pricing sheet.
2) If acceptable, we’ll need a PO and the usual SOC/audit link for compliance.

I attached a short proposal doc and preliminary pricing sheet. Ben — can you confirm the margin math and whether legal needs anything special for the conditional credit language?

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | naomi@redwood.com
attachments: flex_safety_net_proposal_20261218.pdf, pricing_sheet_DN-4821_v2.xlsx
From: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira@clearnorth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T11:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — short-term uplift & credits?

Samira — quick note from pricing: the numbers Naomi proposed are doable; a couple clarifications so finance & procurement know what to expect:

- Exact uplift rate: $0.0085 per 1k tokens for the 48-hour window (flat, no additional surcharges).
- Minimum uplift billing floor: we bill actual usage during the window, but we guarantee a cap at no more than 300% of the daily average to protect you from runaway cost.
- Rollover credit mechanics: credit = 0.7 * billed uplift amount. Applied after signed commit and receipt of PO. It cannot be used retroactively for unpaid invoices — it will be an account credit to be consumed against future invoices.
- Contract conversion incentive: if ClearNorth agrees to 12-month commit >= $75k/month, we’ll extend a 5% on-contract volume discount for the first 3 months in addition to the rollover credit.

Laura — legal will need a short addendum for the conditional credit language. Priyom, can you confirm this aligns with billing system capabilities (credit note issuance + HubSpot tags)?

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira@clearnorth.com>
To: ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: launchio-ops@clearnorth.com
Date: 2026-12-18T15:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — short-term uplift & credits?

Thanks Ben & Naomi — this looks reasonable. A few practical questions before we pull PO: 

1) Can the temporary uplift be toggled back early if usage normalizes? We prefer control.
2) Do you provide the minute-level metering and invoice-ready export (CSV) so our finance team can reconcile?
3) For the rollover credit: will the credit show up as a line on the invoice or do you issue a credit memo? We need to map to our GL.

If answers are OK, we’ll route a PO today and aim to sign a commit in Q1.

—Samira
From: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@clearnorth.com>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T15:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected launch spike — short-term uplift & credits?

Hi Samira — quick answers:  

1) Toggle control: yes — we can activate the uplift and provide a toggle that either Redwood or ClearNorth can trigger to end the uplift early. We’ll document the API call and include a one-click toggle in the console for account admins.

2) Metering export: we’ll provide minute-level usage CSV (invoice-ready) for the uplift window. We already generated the sample you attached; final export will include token counts, pricing lines, and timestamps.

3) Credit mechanics: Redwood will issue a credit memo (credit note) tied to your account; the memo will appear on the invoice ledger and show as a negative line item that maps to GL account 4205 (service credits). We’ll mark the memo with HubSpot deal DN-4821 for traceability.

Laura — please prepare a short addendum template for the conditional credit and PO flow. Ben/Naomi — once we have PO, we can activate the uplift immediately.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. Billing Ops, Redwood Inference
